pylons_vi: 1 tháp BTCT nghiêng 12° về phía Tây, tiết diện chữ V, cao 145 m (134 m trên mặt cầu); dây văng 3 mặt phẳng: 33 dây nhịp chính (1 mặt phẳng giữa), 30 dây neo sau màu đỏ (2 mặt phẳng) hội tụ về mố S1
pylons_en: 1 RC pylon leaning 12° west, V-section, 145 m (134 m above deck); three stay planes: 33 main-span stays in one central plane, 30 red back stays in two planes converging on abutment S1

model3d.notes: Stayed unit 4 × 50 + 230 m (S1–S6), pylon at S5 (VECC general elevation, DCCD, ITST). Pylon 145 m above sea level, 134 m above an ≈11 m deck, leaning 12° west (tip ≈28.5 m behind the base). 33 main stays in one central plane (mast 48–126 m, deck 17–219 m east of S5); 30 back stays = 2 planes × 15 (mast 68–126 m) converging on the last ≈15 m of deck at abutment S1, 181–195 m behind the pylon (VECC drawing). S5 pier ≈15 m along the bridge (oval in reality, drawn as a 15 × 12 m block) and rounded pile cap at the waterline, measured off photos. Back stays use G11 (back_stay_count 15, back_stay_deck_m 181–195).

pylon_custom.description: Single straight RC blade on the deck centreline at pier S5, leaning 12° west (back, away from the 230 m span); V-section tapering from ≈11 m deep along the bridge at deck level to ≈4.5 m at the flat top (glass lantern, 134 m above deck). Rigid with the deck, seated on a wide oval pier and pile cap at the waterline. Main span: one central plane of 33 white stays anchored 48–126 m up the mast. Back side: 2 × 15 red stays from the mast faces (68–126 m) to the two deck edges, all converging on the last ≈15 m of deck at abutment S1 (≈181–195 m behind the pylon) — the twisted red 'sail'.
